pairs.question: Leguntne ista de ueteribus, qui de recentibus conqueruntur?
pairs.answer: Immo legunt et ea non aequitate sed aemulatione coniciunt.
pairs.derivation: Authorial self-question and answer. Dropped the opening interjection 'Pro dolor,' as framing; capitalized 'Leguntne'. The answer is the full first sentence (to the first full stop) which directly answers with 'immo legunt'; stopped there, before the next sentence ('maximo enim illo et ineffabili...') which digresses into the cause of their envy.

pairs.question: Quid enim dicam improbitatem magis an miseriam Romanorum?
pairs.answer: Immo uerius uel improbam miseriam uel miseram improbitatem.
pairs.derivation: Authorial self-question (quid...an) answered by 'immo uerius...'. Dropped the preceding 'Pudet recordationis.' as framing/lead-in; capitalized 'Quid'. Answer is the full answering clause; the next sentence ('quis credat eo tempore...') begins a new rhetorical question, so the window stops at the first full stop.
